C-PROTOCOL-YEAR-IMPORT-RELEASE-306.IntentSummary: Ship the already merged annual protocol import as Kafedra Planner 0.4.3 and replace version-specific, duplicative release orchestration with one universal exact-SHA gate and a build-once verified publisher.

MustPassCommand.Command: node --test tests/release-workflow.test.mjs tests/release-recovery-workflow.test.mjs tests/release-assets-contract.test.mjs tests/release-0.4.1.test.mjs tests/release-0.4.2.test.mjs tests/release-0.4.3.test.mjs tests/deploy-install-contract.test.mjs

T-001.Title: kafedra-release: freeze exact main and define the 0.4.3 release contract

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The release change is based exactly on 81a419f6c8ea2a574d8478ffd33498c1d2a69285 and issue 306.
Schema 31 and immutable source/evidence contracts remain unchanged.

T-002.Title: kafedra-release: make release CI universal and remove duplicated orchestration

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The heavy Release gate runs only on main or manual dispatch and has no version in its name.
The publisher consumes only the successful universal gate, never waits for unrelated workflows and never repeats equivalent unit/browser suites.
Regression tests enforce the universal gate/publisher contract while historical releases are checked through immutable release notes rather than stale workflow comments.

T-003.Title: kafedra-release: verify the same offline artifact through install, update and forced rollback

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The publisher builds one archive and passes its output directory directly to systemd-deploy-selftest before packaging or upload.
The self-test exercises a deterministic ordinary-core post-update failure and proves automatic restoration of previous current, data, PIN and active API/worker after the failed update.

T-004.Title: kafedra-release: synchronize version, operator docs and release notes

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Current release markers are 0.4.3 and historical 0.4.1/0.4.2 documentation remains historical rather than rewritten.
The release note describes annual protocol package import, correction semantics, unchanged schema and safe upgrade.

T-005.Title: kafedra-tests: run relevant exact-head release regression

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Check, unit/integration, smoke, release workflow contracts and GRACE final pass on one unchanged release PR head.
No schema migration or unrelated feature workflow is added merely to satisfy release governance.

T-006.Title: kafedra-release: squash merge exact head and publish v0.4.3

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The exact release PR head is squash-merged and the universal Release gate succeeds on that exact main commit.
The publisher verifies the one built artifact, creates tag v0.4.3 at that commit, uploads exactly seven canonical assets and publishes a non-prerelease GitHub Release.
GitHub API confirms tag target, release state, asset names and SHA-256 evidence before issue 306 is closed.
